user_query: Identify the protein from this amino-acid sequence and summarize its curated or homology-supported function, cellular processes/pathways, and subcellular localization. Clearly distinguish evidence from inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation.organism: Streptomyces coelicolor (strain ATCC BAA-471 / A3(2) / M145)
function: Plays an unknown essential role and a regulatory role in sporulation. Overexpression suppresses sporulation although cell growth rate was not reduced. Impaired differentiation was eliminated by addition of decoyinine, an inhibitor of GMP synthesis. Overexpression has no effect on undecylprodigiosin production, but decreases actinorhodin production.

An essential GTPase which binds GTP, GDP and possibly (p)ppGpp with moderate affinity, with high nucleotide exchange rates and a fairly low GTP hydrolysis rate. Plays a role in control of the cell cycle, stress response, ribosome biogenesis and in those bacteria that undergo differentiation, in morphogenesis control.
subcellular_location: Cytoplasm; Cell membrane; Peripheral membrane protein; No longer associated with the cell membrane after salt-washing.
similarity: Belongs to the TRAFAC class OBG-HflX-like GTPase superfamily. OBG GTPase family.

features.description: Overexpression suppresses sporulation more than the wild-type gene.
Overexpression enhances aerial mycelium formation, also enhances actinorhodin production.
